rounds.ai_message: Good morning. This is Tony from Huaxin Chemical Fiber. How may I help you?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 早上好，我是华信化纤的 Tony，请问有什么可以帮您？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 自我介绍，说明要找涤纶长丝
rounds.common_mistakes: 不要说 'I want buy yarn'；正确说法是 'I am looking for yarn' 或 'I want to buy yarn'。
rounds.tips_zh: 打电话给化纤厂，先报公司和姓名，再直接说明要找的产品大类。
rounds.user_response_example: Good morning, Tony. This is Mark from Hangzhou Lily Garments. I am looking for polyester filament yarn.

rounds.ai_message: We produce POY, DTY and FDY polyester filament. Which type do you need?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 我们生产 POY、DTY 和 FDY 涤纶长丝，您需要哪一种？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 回答需要 DTY，说明用途
rounds.common_mistakes: DTY 直接读字母 D-T-Y 即可，不要拼读成一个单词。
rounds.tips_zh: DTY 是拉伸变形丝，有弹性，针织面料最常用；FDY 是全拉伸丝，多用于梭织。
rounds.user_response_example: We need DTY, the textured yarn, for our knitting fabric.

rounds.ai_message: Sure. What denier and filament count do you need? For example, 150D/48F?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。您需要多少旦尼尔、多少根单丝？比如 150D/48F？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 回答纤度和孔数规格
rounds.common_mistakes: 150D/48F 读作 'one fifty D slash forty-eight F'；D 是总纤度，F 是单丝根数，不要搞反。
rounds.tips_zh: 同样 150D，F 数越高单丝越细，手感越软；48F 是常规，96F、144F 更柔软。
rounds.user_response_example: We need 150D/48F, semi-dull. That is our standard spec for single jersey.

rounds.ai_message: 150D/48F DTY is our best seller. MOQ is one ton. How much do you need?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 150D/48F DTY 是我们的主力产品，起订量一吨。您需要多少？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 回答总数量
rounds.common_mistakes: 纱线数量用 kg 或 ton，不要说 'How many pieces'。
rounds.tips_zh: 化纤长丝本白通常 1 吨起订，色丝起订量更高，下单前先问清 MOQ。
rounds.user_response_example: We need about 5 tons in total, 2 colors. One ton per color is fine for us.

rounds.ai_message: Do you need raw white or dope dyed black? Dope dyed costs more.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 您要本白丝还是原液着色黑丝？色丝价格更高。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 回答要本白还是色丝
rounds.common_mistakes: 本白是 raw white，不要说 'white color yarn'。
rounds.tips_zh: 买本白丝回去织布再染布，是面料厂常规做法；原液着色丝色牢度好但价格高。
rounds.user_response_example: Raw white, please. We will dye the fabric at our own dyeing mill.

rounds.ai_message: Raw white is US$1.35 per kilogram. Lead time is 15 days after deposit.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 本白丝每公斤 1.35 美元，收到定金后 15 天交货。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认价格并尝试小幅议价
rounds.common_mistakes: 问价不要说 'How much price?'；正确是 'What is the price?' 或 'How much is it?'。
rounds.tips_zh: 涤纶长丝价格随原油和 PTA 行情波动，报价一般有效期很短，确认要快。
rounds.user_response_example: Lead time is fine. For 5 tons, could you do US$1.30 per kilogram?

rounds.ai_message: US$1.33 is my best price. We pack on cones, about 5 kg per cone. Is that OK?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 1.33 美元是我的最低价。我们用筒子包装，每筒约 5 公斤，可以吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 接受价格，确认筒子包装
rounds.common_mistakes: 筒子纱说 cone 或 cone yarn，不要说 'roll yarn'。
rounds.tips_zh: 化纤长丝都是筒子装，针织厂直接上机使用；筒重要在合同里写明。
rounds.user_response_example: US$1.33 works for us. Cones are fine, 5 kg per cone is good for our knitting machines.

rounds.ai_message: I will email the proforma invoice today. Please confirm it. Anything else?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 我今天会把形式发票发到您邮箱，请确认。还有其他问题吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 提供邮箱，礼貌收尾
rounds.common_mistakes: PI 是 proforma invoice（形式发票），不要说成 'formal invoice'。
rounds.tips_zh: 收到 PI 后核对品名、规格、数量、单价、交期和付款方式再回签。
rounds.user_response_example: Please send it to mark@lilygarments.com. Thank you for your help, Tony. Talk to you soon.

rounds.ai_message: Hi Mark, Tony from Huaxin Chemical Fiber. I got your RFQ for DTY 150D/48F. Is it for weft knitting or warp knitting?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 你好 Mark，我是华信化纤 Tony。收到你 150D/48F DTY 的询价了，这批丝用于纬编还是经编？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明织造方式和对网络度的要求
rounds.common_mistakes: 纬编是 weft knitting，经编是 warp knitting，不要说反。
rounds.tips_zh: 经编对丝的网络度要求高，否则整经时容易散丝起毛，报价前要先说明用途。
rounds.user_response_example: Hi Tony. It is for weft knitting, single jersey. But please quote both NIM and HIM so I can compare.

rounds.ai_message: For weft knitting, NIM is usually enough. HIM has about 100 nips per meter and costs 3 cents more per kg. Which one do you prefer?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 纬编的话一般 NIM 就够了。HIM 网络点每米约 100 个，每公斤贵 3 美分。你倾向哪种？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 在 NIM 与 HIM 之间做选择并说明理由
rounds.common_mistakes: 网络点是 nips 或 interlace points，不要说 'knots'——knot 是打结，意思完全不同。
rounds.tips_zh: NIM 轻网络、SIM 中网络、HIM 重网络；后道工序张力大选 HIM 更稳妥。
rounds.user_response_example: Let's go with HIM. Our circular knitting machines run at high speed, so we need the intermingle to avoid broken filaments.

rounds.ai_message: Understood. Let me confirm the spec: semi-dull, AA grade, tenacity above 3.5 cN/dtex, elongation 25 plus or minus 3 percent. Any other requirement?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 明白。我确认一下规格：半消光、AA 等级、断裂强力 3.5 cN/dtex 以上、伸度 25%±3%。还有其他要求吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认物性指标，补充条干均匀度要求
rounds.common_mistakes: 化纤强力单位是 cN/dtex，棉纱常用 cN/tex，两个单位不要混用。
rounds.tips_zh: DTY 常规伸度 20%-30%；伸度偏高面料弹性好，但染色缩率也会变大。
rounds.user_response_example: Spec confirmed. Please also keep the Uster evenness CV below 1.5 percent, and send us the test report for each lot.

rounds.ai_message: No problem, we test evenness on Uster Tester 6 for every lot. Now, how many tons in total, and how do you split the colors?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 没问题，我们每个批次都用 Uster 6 型条干仪检测。那么总量多少吨？颜色怎么分配？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明总量与颜色分配，询问色丝 MOQ
key_phrases: raw white and dope dyed black
what is the MOQ for dope dyed
rounds.common_mistakes: 问 MOQ 说 'What is your MOQ?'，不要说 'How many is your MOQ?'。
rounds.tips_zh: 原液着色丝 MOQ 通常 3 吨每色，因为换色要清洗纺丝组件，小单纱厂不愿接。
rounds.user_response_example: 10 tons in total: 7 tons raw white and 3 tons dope dyed black. What is your MOQ for the dope dyed part?

rounds.ai_message: Dope dyed black MOQ is 3 tons per color, so your quantity works. Raw white is US$1.32 per kg, dope dyed black US$1.58. This price is based on this week's PTA cost.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 黑丝起订量每色 3 吨，你的数量没问题。本白每公斤 1.32 美元，黑丝 1.58 美元。这个价格基于本周 PTA 行情。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 议价，询问价格有效期
key_phrases: how long is the price valid
rounds.common_mistakes: 砍价说 'Can you give me a better price?' 即可，不要说 'Please give me cheap price'。
rounds.tips_zh: 涤纶丝价挂钩 PTA 和 MEG 行情，报价有效期一般 3-7 天，行情波动大时锁量锁价要主动谈。
rounds.user_response_example: For a 10-ton order, can you sharpen the black price to US$1.52? Also, how long is this price valid?

rounds.ai_message: I can do US$1.55 for the black, valid for 7 days. One more thing — do you need any twist on the yarn, or zero twist?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 黑丝我可以做到 1.55 美元，有效期 7 天。再确认一点——纱线需要加捻吗？还是无捻？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 回答捻度要求
rounds.common_mistakes: 无捻说 zero twist 或 no twist，不要说 'no TPM'。
rounds.tips_zh: 针织用 DTY 一般无捻；需要加捻的长丝多用于仿真丝雪纺类面料，常用 800-1200 TPM。
rounds.user_response_example: Zero twist for knitting, please. Our jersey fabric does not need any TPM.

rounds.ai_message: Got it. Payment is 30 percent TT deposit, balance before shipment. Delivery 20 days after deposit, on 5 kg paper cones, palletized. Does that work?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。付款方式是 30% 电汇定金，发货前付清尾款。定金到账后 20 天交货，5 公斤纸筒，打托盘。可以吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认付款和交期，提出一个细节要求
rounds.common_mistakes: 'balance before shipment' 指发货前付尾款，不要理解成凭提单付款，两种风险不同。
rounds.tips_zh: 化纤厂常要求款到发货；量大或老客户可谈到凭提单副本付款，第一次合作建议按厂方条款。
rounds.user_response_example: 30 percent deposit is fine, and 20 days is acceptable. Please palletize the cones and wrap each pallet with plastic film for sea shipment.

rounds.ai_message: Sure, we will wrap all pallets. I will send the PI today with spec, price validity, payment and delivery terms. Please counter-sign within this week.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 没问题，托盘都会缠膜。我今天发 PI，写明规格、价格有效期、付款和交期条款，请本周内回签。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认回签时间，结束沟通
key_phrases: looking forward to the first order
rounds.common_mistakes: 回签 PI 说 counter-sign the PI，不要说 'sign back the PI'。
rounds.tips_zh: 回签前重点核对：纤度孔数、等级、物性指标、价格有效期、付款节点和交期起算点。
rounds.user_response_example: We will check the PI and counter-sign by Friday, then arrange the deposit early next week. Looking forward to our first order, Tony.

rounds.ai_message: Mark, straight to the point — PTA futures jumped 6 percent this week, and our filament price will follow next Monday. If you commit 20 tons today, I can hold this week's price for 48 hours. Otherwise I quote fresh.
rounds.ai_message_zh: Mark，开门见山——本周 PTA 期货涨了 6%，我们长丝价格下周一要跟涨。你今天能定 20 吨，我可以把本周价格保留 48 小时，否则只能重新报价。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 不被施压，用量换条件，争取更长锁价期
rounds.common_mistakes: 被催单时直接说 'OK I confirm' 太被动；先谈锁价期限和附加条件再确认。
rounds.tips_zh: 行情上涨期供应商常用涨价逼单，应对方式是用确定的量换锁价期限，并要求书面确认。
rounds.user_response_example: I can commit 20 tons today by email, but I need you to hold the price for 7 days, not 48 hours — our PI approval takes at least 3 working days.

rounds.ai_message: Seven days is a stretch, but fine for 20 tons. Now, your RFQ says AA grade. Honestly, our A grade off-spec rate is under 2 percent and it is 4 cents cheaper. For lining fabric, why pay for AA?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 7 天有点勉强，但 20 吨的量我可以接受。另外，你询价单写的是 AA 级。说实话，我们 A 级的不合格率不到 2%，每公斤还便宜 4 美分。做里布的话，何必买 AA 级？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 坚持等级要求或说明终端用途，不被降级
key_phrases: this is for outerwear, not lining
rounds.common_mistakes: 不要说 'A grade also can'；等级问题含糊会导致大货混等，索赔无据。
rounds.tips_zh: 供应商推荐降级有时是真建议，有时是清库存；关键看终端用途，并在 PI 上锁死等级。
rounds.user_response_example: Tony, this lot is for outerwear shell fabric, not lining. We need AA grade only, and please state 'AA grade, no mixed lots' clearly on the PI.

rounds.ai_message: Noted, AA grade, no mixed lots. By the way, your QC rejected 400 kg from our last shipment, claiming elongation of 32 percent against the 25 plus or minus 3 spec. We pulled the retention samples and they tested within spec. Could your test method be different?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 记下了，AA 级、不混批。顺便说，你们 QC 退了上批货里的 400 公斤，说伸度 32%，超出 25±3 的规格。我们测了留样，结果在规格内。会不会是你们测试方法不一样？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 不回避索赔，提出用第三方检测定责
key_phrases: let's agree on the test standard
rounds.common_mistakes: 测试分歧时不要直接说 'your quality is bad'；先对齐测试标准和方法，否则永远谈不拢。
rounds.tips_zh: 伸度测试受夹持距离、拉伸速度和温湿度影响很大；合同中应写明测试标准（如 GB/T 14344 或 ISO 2062）。
rounds.user_response_example: Let's not argue over whose number is right. I suggest we send the disputed cones to SGS and test per ISO 2062. Whoever is on the wrong side pays the testing fee.

rounds.ai_message: Fair enough, SGS it is. Now for the new order — you want 75D/72F DTY for a lightweight interlock. That is about 1.04 denier per filament, which raises pilling risk. Have you considered 75D/144F microfiber instead?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 可以，就交给 SGS。说回新订单——你要 75D/72F 的 DTY 做轻薄棉毛布，单丝纤度约 1.04 旦，起球风险偏高。有没有考虑过 75D/144F 的细旦丝？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 评估供应商建议，从手感和成本角度回应
key_phrases: send us both cones for trial
rounds.common_mistakes: 单丝纤度 dpf = 总旦数 ÷ F 数；报价比较时要换算成同一纤度再比，不能只看单价。
rounds.tips_zh: F 数翻倍手感更软但价格更高、上机更易擦伤；稳妥做法是要两种筒纱上机试织再定。
rounds.user_response_example: 144F does give a softer hand and better drape. What is the price gap? Please send us two cones of each so we can run a knitting trial before locking the spec.

rounds.ai_message: 144F is 6 cents more per kg. Samples go out tomorrow. One heads-up — if your designer later wants full dull or trilobal bright cross-section, the MOQ doubles and lead time goes to 30 days. Semi-dull round is what we run daily.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 144F 每公斤贵 6 美分，样品明天寄出。提前打个招呼——如果你们设计师后面改要全消光或三角有光截面，起订量翻倍，交期要 30 天。半消光圆孔是我们的日常生产品种。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认截面与光泽规格，把风险点写进合同
key_phrases: luster must match the approved sample
rounds.common_mistakes: 消光程度 semi-dull / full dull / bright 要写进规格书；口语里只说 'dull' 容易误解成全消光。
rounds.tips_zh: 不同光泽和截面混用会导致布面条光不匀，大货必须与确认样同光泽同截面，并在 PI 注明。
rounds.user_response_example: Understood. This season we stay with semi-dull round cross-section. Please put 'semi-dull, round, same luster as approved sample' in the PI to avoid any shade-bar issue.

rounds.ai_message: Will do. Let's talk numbers: 20 tons total, mixed 150D/48F and 75D. I can offer 2 percent off the list price, but I need 30 percent deposit by TT within 3 days, and balance against B/L copy. Deal?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 会的。谈数量吧：总共 20 吨，150D/48F 和 75D 混配。我可以给挂牌价 2% 折扣，但要求 3 天内电汇 30% 定金，尾款凭提单副本支付。成交吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 接受折扣但争取更好的付款节点
rounds.common_mistakes: 'balance against B/L copy' 是凭提单副本付尾款，比款到发货对买方有利，谈判时先争取这一条。
rounds.tips_zh: 老客户身份是谈判筹码：可以用历史订单记录和稳定返单换取更宽松的付款节点和账期。
rounds.user_response_example: Balance against B/L copy works for me, but give me 5 working days for the deposit — our finance runs payment batches twice a week. We have been buying from you for three seasons, so I am sure you can stretch that.

rounds.ai_message: Five working days, agreed. Logistics: I can ship in two lots, but each lot must fill a 20GP container, roughly 10 tons. Splitting a container is not economical for filament. Can your warehouse take two lots 15 days apart?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 5 个工作日，可以。物流方面：我可以分两批出，但每批要装满一个 20 尺柜，约 10 吨。长丝拼箱不划算。你们仓库能接受两批间隔 15 天到货吗？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认分批方案，要求两批质量一致
key_phrases: same spinning line and same lot
rounds.common_mistakes: 整柜是 FCL，拼箱是 LCL；化纤丝体积大货值低，拼箱运费占比高，业内默认走整柜。
rounds.tips_zh: 分批交货要约定两批出自同一纺丝线、批号接近，避免批间条干和染色性差异造成布面问题。
rounds.user_response_example: Two FCL lots 15 days apart are fine. But please make sure both lots come off the same spinning line with adjacent lot numbers, so dye uptake stays consistent.

rounds.ai_message: Agreed — same line, adjacent lots. I will issue the PI today: 20 tons DTY AA grade, semi-dull round, 2 percent discount, 7-day price validity, 30 percent TT deposit in 5 working days, balance against B/L copy, two FCL lots 15 days apart. Counter-sign by Friday?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 同意——同一产线、相邻批号。我今天发 PI：20 吨 DTY、AA 级、半消光圆孔、2% 折扣、价格有效期 7 天、30% 电汇定金 5 个工作日内、尾款凭提单副本、两个整柜间隔 15 天。周五前回签？
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认回签，同时锁定上次索赔的处理方式
key_phrases: PI will be counter-signed by Friday
rounds.common_mistakes: 收尾只确认新单、忘了挂起的历史索赔，等于默认放弃；一定要在 PI 或邮件里书面跟进。
rounds.tips_zh: 复杂订单收尾时把新单条款和历史遗留问题一起书面化，避免口头承诺无据可查。
rounds.user_response_example: The PI will be counter-signed by Friday. One last thing — the 400 kg claim stays open pending the SGS result; please confirm by email that you will issue a credit note if the test goes in our favor.
